assumptions.text: Viewers who watch the videos are likely to support progressive values.
Subscribing and sharing videos will contribute meaningfully to spreading the progressive message.
Audience members have agency and capacity to act on requests to subscribe, join, and share.
The success of the mission depends on viewer participation and engagement.
The speaker's interpretation of public opinion reflects actual majority sentiment in America.
Progressive messages are underrepresented online and need active amplification.
Social media visibility correlates with influence and political impact.
The speaker has moral authority to request viewer action based on shared values.
The audience trusts the speaker’s judgment about what constitutes 'truth' or 'what Americans want'.
